title: Vertical Rod Cursor Projection
description: CAD preview only updates when pointer is inside the green vertical drag tube. Cursor should always project onto the Z axis (including negative Z) via canvas raycast.
summary: Vertical-rod and height-drag previews only updated when the pointer hit the thin cylinder/plane meshes. Added canvas-level ray projection (`SpatialConstrainedPointerBridge`) so pointer.move always maps to the world-Z line through `origin` (negative Z allowed) or the YZ height wall; rod/wall meshes are visual-only.
